title: UN Adds Israel to Annual Blacklist for Sexual Violence in Conflict
detail: The United Nations has added Israel to its annual blacklist of parties accused of committing sexual violence in conflict zones. The move is part of the UN Secretary-General's annual report on conflict-related sexual violence, which lists parties credibly suspected of committing or being responsible for patterns of rape and other forms of sexual violence in armed conflict. Israel's inclusion marks a significant diplomatic development and is expected to draw strong objections from Israeli officials and allied governments.

media.caption: UN adds Israel to blacklist for conflict-related sexual violence
